mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_pair_score p JOIN t_record l ON l.id = p.lost_id JOIN t_record f ON f.id = p.found_id WHERE (p.lost_id = #{recordId} OR p.found_id = #{recordId}) AND p.status = 'MATCHED' AND p.lost_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND p.found_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.is_visible = 1 AND f.is_visible = 1 AND l.status <> 'CLOSED' AND f.status <> 'CLOSED' AND (l.status = 'PENDING' OR l.completed_at > #{cutoff}) AND (f.status = 'PENDING' OR f.completed_at > #{cutoff})

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_pair_score p JOIN t_record other ON other.id = IF(p.lost_id = #{targetRecordId}, p.found_id, p.lost_id) WHERE (p.lost_id = #{targetRecordId} OR p.found_id = #{targetRecordId}) AND other.publisher_id = #{viewerId} AND other.deleted_at IS NULL AND other.is_visible = 1 AND other.status <> 'CLOSED' AND (other.status = 'PENDING' OR other.completed_at > #{cutoff}) AND p.score >= #{threshold} AND p.status <> 'IGNORED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_pair_score p JOIN t_record other ON other.id = IF(p.lost_id = #{recordId}, p.found_id, p.lost_id) WHERE (p.lost_id = #{recordId} OR p.found_id = #{recordId}) AND other.deleted_at IS NULL AND other.is_visible = 1 AND other.status <> 'CLOSED' AND (other.status = 'PENDING' OR other.completed_at > #{cutoff}) AND p.score < #{threshold}

SELECT t.record_id AS record_id, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN p.score >= #{threshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS related, SUM(CASE WHEN p.score < #{threshold} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_confidence, SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'MATCHED' AND p.lost_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND p.found_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matched FROM ( SELECT id AS pair_id, lost_id AS record_id FROM t_pair_score WHERE lost_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT id AS pair_id, found_id AS record_id FROM t_pair_score WHERE found_id IN #{id} ) t JOIN t_pair_score p ON p.id = t.pair_id JOIN t_record l ON l.id = p.lost_id JOIN t_record f ON f.id = p.found_id JOIN t_record other ON other.id = IF(p.lost_id = t.record_id, p.found_id, p.lost_id) WHERE l.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.is_visible = 1 AND f.is_visible = 1 AND l.status <> 'CLOSED' AND f.status <> 'CLOSED' AND (l.status = 'PENDING' OR l.completed_at > #{cutoff}) AND (f.status = 'PENDING' OR f.completed_at > #{cutoff}) AND other.deleted_at IS NULL AND other.is_visible = 1 AND other.status <> 'CLOSED' AND (other.status = 'PENDING' OR other.completed_at > #{cutoff}) GROUP BY t.record_id

SELECT t.record_id, p.id AS pair_id, p.score, p.status, p.engine, p.reason, p.lost_confirmed_at, p.found_confirmed_at, p.lost_unlocked_at, p.found_unlocked_at, p.lost_unlock_note, p.found_unlock_note, CASE WHEN p.lost_id = t.record_id THEN 'LOST' ELSE 'FOUND' END AS my_side, other.id AS counterpart_record_id, other.type AS counterpart_type, other.title AS counterpart_title, other.location AS counterpart_location, other.occurred_at AS counterpart_occurred_at, other.created_at AS counterpart_created_at, other.status AS counterpart_status, (other.contact IS NOT NULL AND other.contact <> '') AS counterpart_contact_present FROM ( SELECT id AS pair_id, lost_id AS record_id FROM t_pair_score WHERE lost_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT id AS pair_id, found_id AS record_id FROM t_pair_score WHERE found_id IN #{id} ) t JOIN t_pair_score p ON p.id = t.pair_id JOIN t_record l ON l.id = p.lost_id JOIN t_record f ON f.id = p.found_id JOIN t_record other ON other.id = IF(p.lost_id = t.record_id, p.found_id, p.lost_id) WHERE p.score >= #{threshold} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.is_visible = 1 AND f.is_visible = 1 AND l.status <> 'CLOSED' AND f.status <> 'CLOSED' AND (l.status = 'PENDING' OR l.completed_at > #{cutoff}) AND (f.status = 'PENDING' OR f.completed_at > #{cutoff}) ORDER BY t.record_id ASC, p.score DESC, p.id ASC
